Resellers and Sales Representatives

ntop software products are available from our e-shop. ntop does not directly manufacture any nBox hardware appliance but there are partners that do that on our behalf. Please contact us for details, price and availability, or get touch with our resellers (A-Z):

Global Distributors

  • Info – Stor (*)

  • SHI International (*)

  • SoftwareOne (*)

(*) Except Brazil.

Americas

  • DataWorld (Canada)

  • FirstLight (USA)

  • Lavineda (Brazil)

  • Sytd (Mexico)

Europe

  • Adaptera (Greece)
  • Anysoft (Poland)

  • Gravitate (Germany – Austria – Switzerland)

  • Hosting Solutions (Europe)

  • Info-Stor (UK – Nordics)
  • Inix Group (Italy)
  • Lugos (France)
  • Miniserver (Europe)
  • Orsenna (France)
  • quattroSEC (Austria)
  • verXo (Italy)
  • Vunkers (Spain)

  • Würth-Phoenix (Europe)

Asia – APAC – Middle East

  • Assured Network Solutions (Australia – New Zealand)

  • Hongke Technology (China – Taiwan)

  • Hosting Global (South Korea)

  • IOE Soft (South Korea]

  • Layer Sistem (Turkey)

  • Linksoft (Taiwan)

  • Jupiter Technology Corp. (Japan)

  • npacket (South Korea)

  • Technovage (Cambodia)
